mapper.select: SELECT rl.receipt_line_id AS receiptLineId,rl.receipt_id AS receiptId,rl.order_line_id AS orderLineId, rl.sku_id AS skuId,rl.base_unit_id AS baseUnitId,rl.base_quantity AS baseQuantity, ol.unit_price_minor AS purchaseUnitPriceMinor,rl.conversion_numerator AS conversionNumerator, rl.conversion_denominator AS conversionDenominator,'CNY' AS currencyCode FROM pur_receipt_line rl INNER JOIN pur_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=rl.tenant_id AND r.receipt_id=rl.receipt_id INNER JOIN pur_purchase_order_line ol ON ol.tenant_id=rl.tenant_id AND ol.order_line_id=rl.order_line_id WHERE rl.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rl.receipt_line_id=#{receiptLineId} AND r.status='CONFIRMED'

SELECT prl.return_line_id AS returnLineId,prl.purchase_return_id AS purchaseReturnId, prl.receipt_line_id AS originalReceiptLineId,prl.sku_id AS skuId,prl.base_unit_id AS baseUnitId, prl.base_quantity AS baseQuantity,'CNY' AS currencyCode FROM pur_purchase_return_line prl INNER JOIN pur_purchase_return pr ON pr.tenant_id=prl.tenant_id AND pr.purchase_return_id=prl.purchase_return_id WHERE prl.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND prl.return_line_id=#{returnLineId} AND pr.status='POSTED'

mapper.update: UPDATE sup_supplier SET status=#{nextState},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND supplier_id=#{supplierId} AND status=#{expectedState} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM((ol.ordered_quantity-ol.received_quantity) * ol.conversion_numerator / ol.conversion_denominator),0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)) FROM pur_purchase_order o INNER JOIN pur_purchase_order_line ol ON ol.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND ol.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND o.supplier_id=#{supplierId} AND ol.sku_id=#{skuId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED') AND ol.received_quantity<ol.ordered_quantity
